claim: The MS Data Alliance Catalogue is an external metadata catalogue for discovering real-world MS data sources; it lists metadata/descriptive data rather than exposing the underlying real-world datasets.
future_grounding_route: Any listed cohort that appears relevant can be routed into the project's acquisition scout and must then be separately verified for access, paired samples, response labels, and module-gene coverage.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging and future acquisition lead generation.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Registry/cohort metadata discovery across MS real-world data sources.
why_unverifiable: The catalogue's metadata and cohort descriptions are externally supplied and not rerunnable from project-held data.
